name: Deadsouls
blurb: Dark priests of the Dead God Gormengorr who have died a second, spiritual death for mastery over the soul itself. They wield spine blades and ancient curses that wither foes to nothing, inflicting a True Death so dreadful it terrifies even the undead.

specialMechanic.name: Doom
specialMechanic.text: Any unit with at least one Doom token takes 4 devil damage at the end of round 4. A unit can only clear a Doom token by slaying another unit.

specialTags.Isolation: Gains extra effects against units with no allies adjacent.
specialTags.Curseproof: Immune to damage and effects from enemy curses.

traits.name: Dread Presence
traits.text: May move through walls. Foes count as isolated when adjacent to this unit unless they have two or more allies adjacent.

acts.name: Doomblade
acts.text: On hit: 1 curse damage, or 2 against Doomed foes, then (3+) foe is Doomed.

souls.name: Cyclopean Monolith
souls.text: Turn start: create a wall in range and inflict 1 weak on an adjacent foe to the wall.

souls.name: Soulfeed
souls.text: All isolated or doomed foes in range take 1 curse damage, gain 1 weak, and this unit gains 1 strength for each.

traits.name: Inverted Crucifix
traits.text: When slain, does not remove Doom, and (5+) Dooms its slayer.

traits.name: Thrall
traits.text: 2 per unit slot; may activate two at a time.

acts.name: Beckon
acts.text: Pull 1 space. Ignores line of sight.

acts.name: Shudder
acts.text: On hit: 1 damage and (4+) Dooms the unit.

upgrades.name: Impending Death
upgrades.text: Beckon has a 4+ effect chance to pull 2.

upgrades.name: Terrorize
upgrades.text: Beckon inflicts 1 weak on isolated units.

traits.name: Teleport
traits.text: When MOVEing a second time or more in a turn, may instead remove self and place anywhere in a free space in range 4.

acts.name: Horrendous Shriek
acts.text: Splash (self): foes gain 1 weak, (5+) and are Doomed. Doomed units take 1 curse damage.

acts.name: Urgal Blade
acts.text: On hit: 2 curse damage. Against isolated units, gain 1 strength and may then MOVE again.

upgrades.name: Terrorize
upgrades.text: Gain 2 strength if Horrendous Shriek hits an isolated foe.

upgrades.name: Soul Frost
upgrades.text: When teleporting, create a space of adverse terrain in the first space vacated.

upgrades.name: Condemn
upgrades.text: Shriek obliterates one unit in its area at 1 hp or lower.

traits.name: Slither
traits.text: Has free movement while adjacent to a wall.

acts.name: Tombraiser
acts.text: Create a wall in range, (3+) then adverse terrain, (5+) then adverse terrain again.

acts.name: Kidnap
acts.text: Pull 1, ignoring line of sight. If pulling into a wall, pull 3 and the unit passes through walls and units during this pull.

acts.name: Serpent's Kiss
acts.text: On hit: 2 damage, then against isolated units inflict 1 weak (4+) and Doom them.

upgrades.name: Ivory Serpent
upgrades.text: Serpent's Kiss also triggers its effects against units standing in adverse terrain.

upgrades.name: Leap
upgrades.text: May step 1 before ACTing, or step 2 and clear a token if adjacent to a wall.

acts.name: Bale Scream
acts.text: Line 4: 1 curse damage. Isolated or Doomed units take 1 curse damage again. May penetrate walls (and gains 1 strength if it passes through one).

acts.name: Tombstone
acts.text: Create a wall in range and (5+) adjacent foes to the wall gain 1 weak.

upgrades.name: Doom Bell
upgrades.text: Tombstone gains effect (6+): adjacent foes are Doomed.

upgrades.name: Freeze Soul
upgrades.text: If Bale Scream slays a unit, it creates adverse terrain instead of a corpse.

upgrades.name: Siren
upgrades.text: Bale Scream pulls all units in its area 2.

traits.name: Labyrinth Master
traits.text: Before MOVEing, may remove and place any adjacent walls in other free adjacent spaces.

traits.name: Tyrant
traits.text: 2x2 unit. Large: ignores elevation, cannot take cover, affected by terrain once.

acts.name: Hell's Grasp
acts.text: Choose an isolated unit. It gains 2 weak and may no longer MOVE or step until the end of its next turn or until no longer isolated.

acts.name: Beckon Lamb
acts.text: Unit gains 1 weak and is pulled 3.

acts.name: Horrendous End
acts.text: On hit: 1 damage, +1 for each of these true of the target: Doomed, Isolated, Weak, in adverse terrain.

upgrades.name: Supremacy
upgrades.text: Attacks against other Tyrants can't be reduced and obliterate instead of slaying.

upgrades.name: To the Slaughter
upgrades.text: Beckon Lamb has no maximum range against Doomed units.
